population.label: the frame hops of the 1040 s cut that carry a coded motion field

instrument: scripts/reuse_codec_mv.py --verify-only: mean |LR_t - warp(LR_t-1, MV)| on the blocks carrying a coded vector, against the un-warped residual on the same blocks
config: H.264 stream copy, PyAV with codec_context.options flags2=+export_mvs, vectors with source == -1, quarter-pel scaled (motion_scale 4), 16x16 blocks
note: the coded motion field is NOT usable as read: warping by it makes the residual 15.6% worse at the median and improves only 24% of the 192 hops. The stream is I B B P ... with two reference indices (-1 and +1), and `source` is a reference-list index whose frame is not exposed by ffmpeg's motion-vector side data, so a vector cannot be mapped to the frame it predicts from without decoder-level bookkeeping - the blocker recorded on the queue row
